name: Resistance-Band External Rotation

instructions.description: Anchor a band beside the body at elbow height.
Hold the band with the elbow bent and close to the side.
Rotate the forearm outward while keeping the upper arm still.
Return slowly without letting the shoulder roll forward.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use a consistent reviewer-defined quality scale for control and alignment.

variations.variationDescription: Resistance-Band External Rotation — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Resistance-Band External Rotation — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.

commentsNotes: Keep the elbow close to the side.
